shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Three uniformly-efficient per-level sizes (126/190/254) bought from a 146,000-cell budget. Wall-mounted junction and breaker boxes bridge power and pipe networks between levels across six supported utility mods. Per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop item 3776015553.
body:
> **NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 utility networks; §31 publishing; §32 pathing cost; §33 cross-level drafted movement. Keep every ⚠ - each cost a run to learn.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. ~81 files, ~25,400 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

**CURRENT PHASE: SHIPPED, OPEN BETA, BACK IN BUILD MODE.** Published 2026-08-01 as **Workshop item 3776015553** (public). See §31.

**⚠ THE VERIFICATION TABLE WAS RE-BASED 2026-08-01.** The user tested the 190/254 tiers, all 15 utility networks, the elevator and the multi-hop router **outside Modmixer**. §9's run log records agent-driven runs ONLY.

**⚠⚠ THE MOST RECENT LESSON, AND THE MOST EXPENSIVE ONE: A COSMETIC EFFECT WAS PUT ON THE CARRY PATH AND BROKE CROSS-LEVEL MOVEMENT OUTRIGHT (run #297).** Reverted. Read §33c before touching `ABStairAnim`.

---

## Status
Visuality, QOL, altitude/weather, settings VERIFIED. **✅ §24b ✅ §24c ✅ §27 ✅ §28 ✅ §29 (#260).**
**✅ §2 NEW LADDER generates clean.** All three tiers exercised.
**✅ §30 ALL 15 NETWORKS LINK AND ARE EXERCISED.**
**✅ §32b DOOR/PAWN BAND SCOPE VERIFIED (#294)** - 50.0% of door writes, 14.3% of pawn checks skipped.
**✅ §33b DRAFTED CROSS-LEVEL ORDERS VERIFIED (#295).** The upward force-move bug is CLOSED.
**⛔ §33c ENTRY ANIMATION REVERTED AFTER BREAKING MOVEMENT (#297).** Pop-out only. `ReadyToCarry` is BUILT, NOT WIRED. **The carry path is now behaviourally identical to the verified #295 build.**
**🔧 §33a PATH LINE: three defects found, all fixed, UNVERIFIED.** Latest: the chain start was the one unlifted point and drew a vertical line.
**🔧 §33e GOTO GHOST: INSTRUMENTED, NOT DIAGNOSED.** `AB2: goto ghost report` names which of four causes it is. **Run it BEFORE `open all bands`** or unfogging masks the leading hypothesis.
**🔧 §8b, §25, §30a BUILT, UNVERIFIED.**
**🔧 §32a CROSS-BAND REJECTION LIVE BUT NEVER FIRED** - needs a raid.
**🔧 §32c HEURISTIC SLIDER SHIPS AT 1.00 (OFF), UNEXERCISED.**
**🎨 ART: 87 of 90 riser textures are placeholders. DISCLOSED. HEADLINE BETA GAP.**
**⚠ CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT IS PARTIAL** - down works, up does not render. DISCLOSED.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount * Slot)`. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + 2) / 64) * 64`; **64-alignment of SLOT is load-bearing**.

**The one insight.** `Region.Neighbors` is *topological, not spatial*. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms, temperature or vacuum. Reachability is not a path: 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK DOES NOT GENERALISE TO UTILITY NETWORKS.** Every power/pipe system builds from raw CELL ADJACENCY (§30).
**⚠ THE GUTTER IS UNBUILDABLE BY CONSTRUCTION** - `AB_OpenAir` declares no affordances.
**⚠ THE GUTTER IS ALSO UNPATHABLE, INCLUDING FOR FLYING PAWNS.** `AB_OpenAir` is `Impassable` and does NOT set `forcePassableByFlyingPawns`, the only exemption `PathGrid.CalculatedCostAt` honours for `PathGridDef Flying`. A band is a sealed pocket for every traversal mode. §32 depends on this.
**⚠ THE MOD IS DOWNWARD-ONLY IN THREE PLACES - ONE DESIGN DECISION IN THREE COSTUMES.** `TryResolveVisibleBelow` descends; the see-through click rule only subtracts; the combat renderer only draws down. **§33b fixed the click case by adding the VIEW BAND as a second input, and that is the template** for the still-open combat case (§13 item 2).
**Hard 1.6 constraints.** No `PathFinder.FindPath`. **⚠ The stack is 2x to 7x anisotropic.** Pathfinder cost: **§32**.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, nine shapes
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Anchor, a fraction of `Size.z` | river/lake centre; VEE Crater | remap the point |
| Field, a gradient on map centre | coastline; VEE LoneIsland | re-centre the sample |
| Noise space, a slice is not a short map | Map Preview; GL grids; Rimefeller oil | generate full height, then crop |
| Distance-to-extent | `CloseToEdge`; river WIDTH | re-base onto the band rect |
| Aspect ratio, normalised by BOTH dims | preview + reroll grid | lay out from the BAND, generate at the STACK |
| Map-wide scalar | snow melt, temperature, GL roof sweep | rewrite per cell at the consumer |
| Foreign absolute writes | GL landform lands in band 0 | ORDER, not arithmetic |
| Radius search wider than the gutter | `ConnectMaxDist` 6 vs a 3-cell gap | clip the rect to the band |
| **Whole-map list sweep** (§32) | every door / every pawn, per path request | bucket the list per band |

Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley. **`ABBandLocal.cs` is THE canonical FIELD rewrite** plus `BandLocalModule`.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — budget 146,000, ladder 7 / 4 / 2

| size | slot | gutter | gap | cost/band | playable | max levels | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 126 | 128 | 2 | 3 | 16,128 | 98.4% | 7 (cap) | 112,896 |
| **190** | 192 | 2 | 3 | 36,480 | 99.0% | **4** | 145,920 |
| 254 | 256 | 2 | 3 | 65,024 | 99.2% | 2 | 130,048 |

**⚠ EXACTLY ONE MAXIMALLY EFFICIENT HEIGHT PER 64-STEP** (`slot - 2`: 62, 126, 190, 254, 318). Anchoring 190 *determined* the rest.
**⚠ UNIFORM GUTTER IS A TESTING WIN** - the confound §30a walked into is gone.
**⚠ WHAT WAS GIVEN UP.** 250/300 were vanilla Medium/Large exactly. **318 is blocked by arithmetic.** **62 is deliberately absent.** **The wide gutter was real safety and is gone.**
**⚠ THE BUDGET'S STATED JUSTIFICATION WAS PARTLY WRONG - THE BUDGET ITSELF IS NOT.** See §32.
**⚠ 200 IS THE ONE NUMBER TO AVOID** - gutter 56, 21.9% wasted. **Waste is a SAWTOOTH.**
**Old saves are safe.** **⚠ THE PLAN PERSISTS BETWEEN COLONIES.** **⚠ Own the widget, do not patch the data.**

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA
**Cross-band movement** segmented at ONE interception (`Pawn_PathFollower.StartPath`); hops strictly decrease.
**⚠⚠ TWO CARRY TRIGGERS EXIST - THE PER-TICK SWEEP AND `PatherArrived` - AND NOTHING MAY GATE EITHER.** §3 records that when they disagreed, whether a transit completed depended on which fired first. §33c records the opposite error: adding a NEW condition to both. **They must agree on the same OUTCOME; that is not a licence to put a new precondition on the carry.** Gating `TryConsumeArrival` in particular suppresses vanilla's `PatherArrived`, which turns the whole thing into a re-segmentation loop.
**⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE: `TryResolveVisibleBelow`.** TEN systems share it; NINE appearances of the single-step bug.
**⚠ THE BELOW VIEW IS MIRRORED PASSES, NOT ONE RENDERER.** **⚠ THREE THINGS ARE CALLED "MASS".** **⚠ MASS FILL IS EMITTED FROM THREE PLACES.** **⚠ VISIBILITY IS `ABBands.ShowsBelow(terrain)`.**
**⚠ EVERY FOREIGN NETWORK SHIPS ITS OWN `SectionLayer` AND NONE ARE MIRRORED** (§30f).
**Water** is TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE, **all three patches inert under GL**.
**⚠ PERSPECTIVE MODE WAS BUILT AND REMOVED. Do not re-add as polish.**
Ore `x(1+0.45*(depth-1))`. **⚠ The snow line never worked.** Camera clamp + level-switch share `ABGuard.Camera`.

# 8b. THE DEPTH SHRINK — SCOPE IS LOOSE CONTENTS ONLY
`ABDepthView` is the ONE definition (`ScaleForLevels`, 60-100%, default 85%). Consumers: the printed mesh and the realtime pawn pass (`Patch_PawnRenderer_ABBelowShrink`).
**⚠ BUILDINGS DO NOT SHRINK. `CanShrink` IS AN ALLOW-LIST ON `ThingDef.category`:** Item, Plant, Filth. **Pawns take the realtime path and DO shrink.**
**⚠ THE REASON IS THAT TERRAIN IS NEVER SHRUNK.** A shrunken building no longer fits its footprint and reads as *wrong size*, not distance. HARD rule.
**⚠ THE `linkType` TEST IS KEPT** - mods ship linked PLANTS and ITEMS.
**⚠ THE PAWN MATRIX CARRIES TWO EFFECTS (§33c) AND THEY MULTIPLY IN ONE POSTFIX.** Do not add a second `[HarmonyPatch]` on `GetDrawParms`.

# 9. GENERATION COST
**9a.** The profile stamps its own conditions. Has voided or explained EIGHT comparisons. **⚠ THE WATER REPORT DOES NOT AND SHOULD.**
**⚠ THE TABLE RECORDS AGENT-DRIVEN RUNS ONLY.**
**OLD LADDER**: #231 7x126 ~5.7 s | #236 3x250 ~12.4 s | #237 5x190 ~6.9 s | #255 5x190 Boreal **~4.1 s** | #259/#260 +Caves ~5.3/5.8 s.
**NEW LADDER** (all 5x126): #276 ~2.9 s | #277 +Caves +River ~3.4 s | #278 ExtremeDesert rain 158 **~1.6 s** | #279 ~2.8 s | **#294-#297 Mountainous ExtremeDesert rain 139 ~3.1 s** (carve 1,998 ms, **1,575 of it `FillRock band 0`**).
**⚠ THE NEW LADDER'S WHOLE RANGE SITS BELOW THE OLD LADDER'S BEST.**
**⚠ FillRock is SUPERLINEAR in band size** and dominates a mountainous tile.
**⚠ RAINFALL DOMINATES `GenStep_Plants`** - a 21x spread on the same plan.
**⚠ THE `Caves` CLAIM IS DEMOTED TO A RANGE.** n=2 was not a pattern.
**⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES WHETHER A RENDERING TEST IS VALID AT ALL.**
**⚠ `Pathing.RecalculateAllPerceivedPathCosts` RUNS AT EVERY `Map.FinalizeInit`, ONCE PER `PathGridDef` WITH A WORKER** - 3 x NumGridCells managed `CalculatedCostAt` calls on generation AND save load.
**9g. RE-RANKED.** 1. **Basement rock suppression** (~1.0-4.3 s). 2. `GenStep_Plants` (demoted). 3. `GenStep_RockChunks`. 4. Ruins. 5. Perlin precompute.

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
59.6 fps at 96 pawns. **⚠ THAT MEASURES THE WRONG THING** - cost is in section-regeneration BURSTS.
**⚠ BISECT TOGGLES PERSIST ACROSS RUNS, AND THE STAMP IS WHY WE CATCH IT.**
**⚠ The pre-pinned palette always strips its LAST entry. n=21.** Pad with a DISTINCT throwaway.
**⚠ OUR PROFILE / BISECT / RISER / PATHING lines arrive as `warning` ROWS ATTRIBUTED TO US** - a run reporting only those is CLEAN. **Info is filtered out of the bridge.**
**⚠⚠ A CLEAN LOG IS NOT A WORKING FEATURE.** #297 logged nothing but the generation profile while cross-level movement was completely broken. The bridge sees THROWN EXCEPTIONS; a patch that returns the wrong bool is silent. **Never report "clean run" as if it were evidence the change worked.** What a clean run does prove, cheaply and on every launch: no `Skipped patch class` warning means every `[HarmonyPatch]` resolved its target.
**⚠ AN ERROR HASH IS A STACK SIGNATURE, NOT A FILE.**
**⚠ INSTRUMENT BEFORE THE THIRD GUESS.**
**⚠ TWO COUNTERS IN DIFFERENT PATCHES THAT SHOULD TRACK 1:1 ARE A FREE CROSS-CHECK** (#294: 433 vs 432).

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **ART.** 87 of 90 riser textures are placeholders - a public promise now.
2. **CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT: upward shooting does not render.** **§33b is the template.**
3. **RE-VERIFY CROSS-LEVEL COMMANDING** after the #297 revert. **Highest priority - this is a core feature that was broken and is now believed restored, not confirmed.**
4. **VERIFY §33a path line** on a route that TURNS.
5. **DIAGNOSE §33e ghost** with `AB2: goto ghost report`, run BEFORE `open all bands`.
6. **§33c entry animation: redesign from outside the carry decision, or drop it.**
7. **VERIFY §8b, §30a, §25.** 8. **VERIFY §32a with a raid.** 9. **§32c slider unexercised.**
10. **Basement rock suppression.** 11. **§30 polish:** `PipeGrid[P, cell]` not rewritten on merge (cosmetic).
12. §18 audit; VEE compat; GL roof fix; reroll grid; camera anchor; preview at 254.
13. **Never exercised:** basement PATHING, cavern basement.
14. §22 TABLED. 15. CAI 5000 (§26). 16. §30g. 17. §30e Rimefeller oil.
18. **Delete orphaned Workshop item 3773267907.** 19. **§32f.**

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove a subsystem innocent by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. Change one thing per experiment. **Run the diagnostic before the third theory** - and when there is none, BUILD ONE. A beautiful fit is not evidence.
**⚠⚠ A COSMETIC EFFECT MUST NEVER SIT ON THE CODE PATH THAT DECIDES WHETHER THE FEATURE HAPPENS** (§33c). An 18-tick animation hold was inserted into both carry triggers and broke cross-level movement outright. The hold was bounded, self-cancelling and outlived by the existing timeout - **all true, and all beside the point, because the thing it blocked was the loop's own exit condition.** When a change touches a decision path, the question is not "how long does it block for" but "what else depends on this returning".
**⚠ WHEN A CORE FEATURE REGRESSES, REVERT FIRST AND DIAGNOSE AFTER.** The fix for #297 was to restore the known-good path in one edit, not to reason about which of the two gates was at fault. Diagnosis is cheap once the user is unblocked and expensive while they are not.
**⚠ A CORRECT PRINCIPLE APPLIED TO THE WRONG THING IS STILL A BUG.** "Both carry triggers must consult the same gate" is right when they decide the SAME OUTCOME (§3). It is not a licence to add a NEW precondition to both, which is how one bad idea got installed in two places at once.
**⚠ THE AGENT'S TEST LOG IS NOT THE PROJECT'S TEST HISTORY.** **Before writing an untested claim into player-facing copy, ASK.**
**⚠ A GUARD CLAUSE THAT SILENTLY EARLY-RETURNS IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM AN UNIMPLEMENTED FEATURE.**
**⚠ A PERFORMANCE CLAIM COPIED INTO THREE FILES IS STILL ONE UNVERIFIED CLAIM** (§32). **Duplication made it look corroborated.**
**⚠ A BURST-COMPILED METHOD CANNOT BE HARMONY PATCHED, AND FAILS SILENTLY.** `PathGridJob` and `PathFinderJob` are Burst structs. **Corollary: a job holding MANAGED references can never be Burst, so it IS patchable.**
**⚠ THE CHEAPEST OPTIMISATION IS DELETING WORK THAT CANNOT MATTER.**
**⚠ AN OVERLAY MUST AGREE WITH WHERE THE RENDERER PUTS THE THING, NOT WHERE THE THING IS** (§33a).
**⚠ FIXING A HELPER DOES NOT FIX ITS CALL SITES - AUDIT THEM.** `LocalizeForPawn` was corrected to lift into the view band, and a line ten rows below it in the same file still used `pawn.Position.ToVector3Shifted()` raw, drawing a vertical line off screen. The broken call site did not call the helper at all, so fixing the helper could never reach it. **After changing a shared transform, grep for the raw operation it replaced.**
**⚠ THREE COPIES OF ONE TRANSFORM, TWO OF THEM RIGHT.** The majority being correct is exactly why the odd one survived.
**⚠ A SYMPTOM CAN BE TWO DEFECTS WITH OPPOSITE FIXES - AND THEN A THIRD** (§33a). **Count the defects before writing the patch.**
**⚠ WHEN YOU COPY A LOOP OUT OF ENGINE CODE, COPY ITS DIRECTION TOO.** `Peek(n)` = `nodes[curNodeIndex - n]`: ascending runs FORWARD. **Check against a route that TURNS** - a reversal is invisible on a straight corridor.
**⚠ A STATELESS EFFECT IS WORTH NOTHING IF THE STATE IT READS NEVER CHANGES** (§33c). **Check the range your input can actually take before congratulating yourself on avoiding state.**
**⚠ REUSING A RADIUS IS REUSING ITS REASONS.** `ArriveRadius` is 3 because a blocked pawn can only get that close; reusing it for the ANIMATION made pawns stop and shrink three cells short. **Two questions, two constants.**
**⚠ AN ASSUMPTION THAT TWO THINGS COINCIDE IS A CLAIM ABOUT A GUARANTEE - GO FIND IT.** Both wormhole ends lift onto the same point for RISERS (`(x, z ± Slot)`), NOT for STAIRS, which pair arbitrarily. **A guarantee in one subsystem is not a guarantee in its neighbour.**
**⚠ A VISUAL EFFECT IS ONLY CORRECT RELATIVE TO WHAT IT IS *NOT* APPLIED TO** (§8b).
**⚠ HALF-IMPOSED ORDERING IS WORSE THAN NONE.** **⚠ COUNT THE EMITTERS BEFORE FIXING THE LOOK.** **⚠ CLEAR THE OTHER SUSPECT BY READING ITS DATA, NOT ITS CODE.** **⚠ A FIX FOR MOD X CAN BE A REGRESSION FOR EVERYONE WITHOUT X.** **⚠ REPRODUCING A SUBSYSTEM MEANS REPRODUCING ALL OF IT.** **⚠ REUSING A PREDICATE IS REUSING ITS HIDDEN CONDITIONS.** **⚠ TWO RESOLVERS FOR ONE QUANTITY IS A BUG WITH A DELAY FUSE.** **⚠ ASK HOW THE SUBSYSTEM REPRESENTS THE THING, NOT WHAT THE THING IS.**
**⚠ CHECK THAT YOUR CONFIGURATION CAN EXPRESS THE DIFFERENCE.** **⚠ A QUANTISED PARAMETER HAS FEWER LEGAL VALUES THAN IT LOOKS.** **⚠ A BUDGET SET BY THE HEAVIEST OPTION IS PAID BY EVERY USER.** **⚠ A COST MODEL CAN GOVERN THE WRONG AXIS AND STILL LOOK CORRECT.** **⚠ IF THE CHEAPEST OPTION LOOKS LIKE THE MOST EXPENSIVE, THE UI IS LYING.** **⚠ n=2 IS NOT A PATTERN, AND NEITHER IS n=4.**
**⚠ N MODS CAN BE FEWER THAN N PROBLEMS - COUNT THE CODEBASES.** **⚠ A FOREIGN MOD'S OWN DEFS CAN BE WRONG.** **⚠ A DEPENDENCY LIST NAMES THE REAL PATCH TARGET.** **⚠ GATE AGAINST THE HOST MOD'S OWN UNLOCK.** **⚠ AN ENUM IS A CAPABILITY LIST, NOT A CONTENT LIST.** **⚠ TWO CALL SITES OF ONE CONSTANT CAN NEED TWO DIFFERENT FIXES.** **⚠ A DECOMPILE SHOWS THE API OF THE VERSION THAT MOD WAS BUILT AGAINST.**
**⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT IS ALREADY BUILT BEFORE BUILDING IT** - three times now: §33a's job-line localizer, the "suppress vanilla and draw our own" proposal (already shipped), and the goto ghost (never deleted; we call vanilla's own `RenderPawnAt`).
**⚠ A LOSSY NORMALISER IS NOT A WAY TO READ A CHOICE.** **⚠ A DESIGN CHOICE RECORDED WITHOUT ITS COST WILL BE READ AS FREE.** **⚠ THE REAL CONFLICT IS USUALLY A REPLACEMENT, NOT A COLLISION.**
**⚠ Compat work is mostly deletion.** **⚠ Waste is often a sawtooth.** **⚠ A comment is not an invariant - and a comment that has gone FALSE is worse than none.** **⚠ Steady-state fps hides burst cost.** **⚠ Timing that reads exactly 0.0 ms is an early return.** **⚠ In a foreign log, the loudest error is usually downstream.**
**Patching.** Re-aim the shared parameter. Find the ONE method everything funnels through - and when there is none, **wrap the DATA instead of the reader** (§32). Patch the PRODUCER, not the store. Own the widget. **Never put a foreign type in a patch signature**; **when the offending parameter is a PRIVATE NESTED STRUCT, omit it - Harmony binds by name.** **Prefix state is released in a Finalizer.** **Prefer "detect, then redo" over "always redo".**
**⚠ REIMPLEMENT RATHER THAN POSTFIX WHEN THE GEOMETRY IS A CHAIN.** Job lines and the path line both build each segment from where the last ended. **And when you reimplement, you now own every branch of the original - including the ones you did not notice.**
**Engine facts.** `SnowGrid.CanHaveSnow` rejects on `holdSnowOrSand=false` OR a Full-fillage edifice. A `TerrainHard` shader IGNORES vertex alpha; set `renderQueue` AFTER shader assignment. **Draw order between terrain materials is render QUEUE.** A `dontRender` terrain emits only a ShadowMask. `Banded` is FALSE during map generation. FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread. **Gensteps run with live-map bookkeeping DEFERRED (~40x cheaper).** Harmony always runs FINALIZERS. **`FogGrid` is a `NativeBitArray` in 1.6.** **Vanilla rock links with `MapEdge`.** **`Graphic_Multi.Init` falls back to `_east` with `westFlipped`.**
**⚠ RENDERER FACTS THAT BIT TWICE.** Past `ZoomRootSize` 18 a humanlike renders from a **cached atlas blit that ignores `PawnDrawParms.matrix`** - fix is `disableCache`. **`PawnRenderer.GetDrawParms` is reached from `ParallelPreDraw`, i.e. potentially on WORKER THREADS** - gate dictionary probes behind a plain int count. **`PawnDrawParms.pawn` gives you the pawn inside the postfix.** **A uniform x/z Scale commutes with the pawn's facing rotation so it can be right-multiplied; a TRANSLATION does not and must be left-multiplied.** **`MultiPawnGotoController.Draw` draws the destination GHOST via `pawn.Drawer.renderer.RenderPawnAt(loc, Rot4.South)` and skips any cell that is `Fogged`.**
**⚠ WALL-MOUNTED DRAW LAYER IS `Item`, NOT `BuildingOnTop`.** **⚠ SOUTH-FACING WALL MOUNTS NEED ZERO DRAW OFFSET WHILE N/E/W NEED 0.9.**
**⚠⚠ RIMWORLD HAS TWO UNRELATED "WALL-MOUNTED" MECHANISMS IN DIFFERENT CELLS.** `isAttachment` + `Placeworker_AttachedToWall` takes the OPEN cell BESIDE a wall and **the wall must declare `supportsWallAttachments` - ORDINARY COLONY WALLS DO NOT**. `canPlaceOverWall` + `PlaceWorker_OnWall` takes the WALL'S OWN cell - **what players mean**. **`isEdifice=false` + `clearBuildingArea=false` both load-bearing.**
**⚠ POWER FACTS.** `ContiguousPowerBuildings` is PRIVATE; flood over `GenAdj.CellsAdjacentCardinal`. **`ConnectMaxDist = 6`** with NO line-of-sight check. **`Building.TransmitsPowerNow` is VIRTUAL and the base IGNORES flicking.** **⚠ A `private const` IS INLINED AND CANNOT BE READ BY REFLECTION.**
**⚠ PATHFINDER FACTS (§32).** `PathGridJob` is deduped through `gridJobLookup`, cleared every `PathFinderTick` - once per distinct VARIANT per tick, **and `Area`/`AvoidGrid` are part of that key**. `PathFinderJob.Execute` opens with `calcGrid.Clear()` over a 20-byte `CalcNode` per cell. `PathFinderTick` opens with `ForceCompleteScheduledJobs()`, so **no path job straddles a tick boundary**. `FindPathNow` is SYNCHRONOUS and ~10 vanilla JobGivers use it. `hCost = octile * 13 * heuristicStrength`; 1.0 is admissible, vanilla ships 1.75 for animals. **`PawnPath` is POOLED - copy nodes out and dispose.** **`Peek(n)` = `nodes[curNodeIndex - n]`.**
**⚠ COLLECTION FACT THAT COST A SESSION.** **`HashSet<T>` implements `ICollection<T>` but NOT the non-generic `ICollection`.**
**⚠ TEXTURE FACTS.** **Core textures are PACKED.** **TWO art families**: Dubwise thick near-black outline; Vanilla/VE almost none. **Describe the SPRITE, not the object.**

# 21-29. BUG RECORDS
**21 -> §25. ⚠ THE MECHANISM I NAMED WAS WRONG AND THE FIT WAS PERFECT.**

# 33. CROSS-LEVEL DRAFTED MOVEMENT

## 33a. THE PATH LINE — THREE DEFECTS UNDER ONE SYMPTOM
1. **Before the hop it does not exist.** `TrySegment` rewrites the destination to the near anchor before the pather builds a path.
2. **After the hop it exists a full Slot off screen.** `DrawPath` draws true world coordinates; `ABBelowDynamicDraw` draws the pawn lifted.
3. **The preview was REVERSED per leg.** `Peek(n)` = `nodes[curNodeIndex - n]`, ascending runs FORWARD. **Invisible on a straight corridor.**
4. **And the CHAIN START in the job-line replacement was the one unlifted point**, drawing a line vertically off screen toward the pawn's real coordinates. Fixed only after `LocalizeForPawn` itself had been corrected - **the broken call site did not use the helper**.

**Fix.** `Patch_PawnPath_ABLiftPathLine` reimplements `DrawPath` lifted into the VIEW band (**reimplemented, not postfixed - the geometry is a chain**) plus `ABTransitVisuals.DrawRemainingRoute`.
**⚠ VANILLA WAS ALREADY FULLY SUPPRESSED** - any remaining line bug is in OUR replacement.
**⚠ THE FAR SIDE IS A REAL PATH:** `FindPathNow` per same-band leg, walking the hop chain. **⚠ RUNS FROM A DRAW CALLBACK**, so lazy, cached on the NEAR ANCHOR, refreshed every 150 ticks. **⚠ `PawnPath` IS POOLED.**
**⚠ HOP SEGMENTS ARE SKIPPED EXPLICITLY** via a `hops` index list - both ends coincide for RISERS, not for STAIRS.

## 33b. ✅ FORCE-MOVE UP — VERIFIED (#295)
`TryTranslateForOrder` rewrote any cross-band click onto the pawns' band, so every upward order became a same-band shuffle. **Fix: the VIEW BAND is the discriminator**, gated on `AnyCanReach`. Applies to ALL orders.
**⚠ `Patch_RCellFinder_ABOrderedGotoBand` WAS ALREADY CORRECT.** **⚠ THE ORIGINAL TRANSLATION IS NOT A BUG AND MUST SURVIVE** - it fixed "three drafted pawns, only one moves".

## 33c. ⛔ THE STAIR ANIMATION — ENTRY HALF REVERTED, POP-OUT ONLY
**Attempt 1 (distance-driven, no hold): never played.** `ArriveRadius` is 3 and the shrink radius was 4, so the pawn was carried the instant it entered the zone - peak progress 0.25 for one tick.
**Attempt 2 (18-tick hold in both carry triggers): BROKE CROSS-LEVEL MOVEMENT ENTIRELY (#297).** Suspected mechanism, unproven: gating `TryConsumeArrival` suppresses vanilla's `PatherArrived`, so the leg never completes, the job re-issues `StartPath`, `TrySegment` re-segments (the real destination is still on another band) and the pawn re-arrives at the same anchor - a re-segmentation loop that reads as "the order does nothing".
**Reverted. `ReadyToCarry` is kept, UNWIRED, with the analysis attached.** The carry path is now behaviourally identical to the verified #295 build.
**⚠⚠ THE RULE: NOTHING COSMETIC MAY SIT ON THE PATH THAT DECIDES WHETHER A TRANSIT HAPPENS.** The pop-out obeys it by construction - a pure read of "when did the hop occur", recorded AFTER the fact. **Any third attempt at the entry half must be driven from outside the carry decision** (a predictive effect keyed on proximity with a radius wide enough to actually play, or a retrospective ghost drawn at the near anchor after the fact).
**⚠ AND IF IT IS RE-ATTEMPTED, IT NEEDS ITS OWN RADIUS.** `AnimateRadius` (1.5) exists because reusing `ArriveRadius` (3) made pawns stop and shrink three cells short of the stairs.
**Still true and still worth keeping:** it composes with the depth cue in the ONE existing `GetDrawParms` postfix; their guards differ (`BelowDrawScale` is armed only inside the see-below pass, so early-returning on it would skip the common case); the cached atlas blit past `ZoomRootSize` 18 needs `disableCache`; and `GetDrawParms` reaches worker threads, so probes are gated behind int counts.
